column1: # OCCAM ABLATION ARMS -- the single source of truth for scripts/ablation/ablate.py
# WHY. Which parts of the official rhj_fewshot model (Y06) carry its performance? Every arm is Y06
# with exactly ONE thing changed, trained on rhj_fewshot at seeds 42-46, scored at 5 split-halves on
# rhj_fewshot, h1_seen, k562_seen and k562_seen_h1set (nocal). Plan and results: docs/ABLATION_PLAN.md.
# Reference arm for every axis = Y06 itself (seed 42 = the published run, 43-46 = S4N_Y06).
#   arm           id; run dirs are runs/rhj_fewshot_S<seed>_<arm>__<tag>, so it must be unique
#   axis          A = perturbation representation, B = loss terms, C = encoder
#   change        the ONE thing that differs from Y06, in words
#   grid          overrides of the Y06 grid row, `column=value` comma-separated ('-' = none);
#                 column names are the header of scripts/grids/rhj_seeds.tsv
#   cos_w         profile-cosine weight (Y06: 0.5); passed to the launcher as COS_W
#   extra_sets    config overrides passed as EXTRA_SETS, space-separated `key=value` ('-' = none)
#   status        ready | needs-code (launch refuses needs-code arms)
